sentences.en: Why do you think he chose to become a psychologist?
sentences.zh: 你认为他为什么选择成为一名心理学家？

sentences.en: To my surprise, the noted psychologist was accused of a kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 令我惊讶的是，那位著名的心理学家被指控绑架。

sentences.en: The psychologist asked me a whole battery of questions.
sentences.zh: 心理学家问我一连串的问题。

senses.zh: 心理学研究者，心理学家
